full_judgment: 18. Mr Khair Ezaz Maswood next submits that although the bid of the petitioner-company was accepted by the Executing Court in compliance with the judgment and order of the High Court Division dated 23-8-2004 passed in this Writ Petition, yet the fact remains that after the reversal of the judgment and order of the High Court Division dated 23-8-2004 by the Appellate Division in the Civil Appeal No. 135 of 2006, the entire matter starting from the passing of the impugned order dated 11-4-2004 stands re-opened for fresh adjudication on merit by this Court and this Court will now re-adjudicate upon the Rule on merit in accordance of the directive given by the Appellate Division in the Civil Appeal No 135 of 2006.
